LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Spin013.nodes.0.label: Turning Edge
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Spin013.nodes.0.descripti: Retains your learned spin ability. When Spin deals actual damage, slash that victim for 25 extra damage. Three-second shared cooldown across all victims; bonus damage cannot trigger this again. Base rewards: damage 25.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Spin013.nodes.1.label: Honed Edge
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Spin013.nodes.1.descripti: Three ordinary hits on the same enemy within 4 seconds leave a blade mark for 4 seconds. A later actual Spin hit consumes it for 50 extra slashing damage. Three-second marking cooldown; only one victim is marked at a time. Base rewards: damage 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Spin013.nodes.2.label: Turning Guard
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Spin013.nodes.2.descripti: When Spin deals actual damage, gain a separate 50-point shield lasting 3 seconds. Four-second cooldown; hitting more victims with the same spin does not stack it. Base rewards: shield 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Spin013.nodes.3.label: Following Edge
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Spin013.nodes.3.descripti: When Honed Edge deals actual bonus damage, slash the nearest other enemy within 3 cells for 25 damage. Three-second cooldown. This strike cannot trigger Honed Edge or spread again. Base rewards: damage 25.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Spin013.nodes.4.label: Renewing Cut
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Spin013.nodes.4.descripti: When Honed Edge deals actual bonus damage, heal up to 2 of your non-permanent injury. Four-second cooldown. Full health produces no healing; fully absorbed bonus damage grants none. Base rewards: healing 40.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Spin013.nodes.5.label: Turning Cover
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Spin013.nodes.5.descripti: When Spin deals actual damage, grant the nearest other colonist within 4 cells a separate 50-point shield for 3 seconds. Four-second cooldown. Without an eligible ally it does not trigger or add another shield to you. Base rewards: shield 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Spin013.nodes.6.label: Stay in the Fight
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Spin013.nodes.6.descripti: When Spin deals actual damage, heal up to 2 of your non-permanent injury. Six-second cooldown; extra victims in the same spin do not repeat healing. Full health grants nothing. Base rewards: healing 40.
